# AI Brain Startup (`aibrainstartup.com`)

> Building Persistent Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Agent Infrastructure for Enterprises and Researchers.

## Executive Overview
AI Brain is a next-generation intelligence architecture designed to remember, learn, reason, and act autonomously. It provides persistent long-term memory systems, continuous vector embedding graphs, and domain-tailored autonomous agent networks.

## Core Architecture & Subsystems
- **Conversation Memory**: Retains complete semantic context across long-term interactions.
- **Idea Memory**: Indexes, correlates, and synthesizes raw creative thoughts into structured hypotheses.
- **Project Memory**: Tracks codebase state, milestones, and architectural decisions persistently.
- **Knowledge Graph**: Self-evolving multi-dimensional entity relationship web.
- **Autonomous Agent Network**: Specialized runtime agents including Research Agent, Coding Agent, Strategy Agent, Knowledge Agent, and Automation Agent.
